curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Left entirely on her own in a crumbling house, where do the borders of her protective fantasies end and real-world peril begin?
curatedMovie.description: Abandoned on a decaying country estate due to the reckless actions of her parents, a young girl retreats into a vivid, surreal inner world to endure her profound isolation.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Slow, somber, and deeply imaginative, balancing emotional heaviness with tense, engaged isolation best suited for solo viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Terry Gilliam, this singular drama blends dark fantasy and suspense to craft a heavy, unconventional portrait of a child's psychological resilience.
